#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long qmod(long long a, long long b, long long mod) {
    long long ans = 1;
    while (b >= 1) {
        if ((b & 1) != 0) {
            ans = ans * a % mod;
        }
        a = a * a % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    vector<vector<long long>> S(5005, vector<long long>(5005, 0));
    long long mod = 998244353;
    S[1][1] = 1;
    S[0][0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 5000; i++) {
        S[i][i] = 1;
        S[i][0] = 0;
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= 5000; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
            S[i][j] = (S[i - 1][j] * j % mod + S[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
        }
    }

    long long n, m;
    int k;
    cin >> n >> m >> k;
    m = qmod(m, mod - 2, mod);

    vector<long long> dp(5005, 0);
    dp[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= min(n, (long long)k); i++) {
        dp[i] = dp[i - 1] * (n - i + 1) % mod;
    }

    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= min(n, (long long)k); i++) {
        ans = (ans + dp[i] * qmod(m, i, mod) % mod * S[k][i] % mod) % mod;
    }

    cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
